prompt:
Restate this requirement as a different engineer would write it, preserving exactly the same obligation (who, modality, action, bound, condition); do not copy phrasing; give 3 restatements; then give 1 alteration that changes exactly one element (modality, quantity, actor, action or condition) and name which element.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else: {"restatements": ["...", "...", "..."], "alteration": {"text": "...", "element": "modality|quantity|actor|action|condition"}}

restatements.text: Searches shall be answered by the system within 2 seconds.
The system must respond to a search request within 2 seconds.
The system shall respond to a search request within 2 s.

alteration.text: The system shall respond to a search request within 3 seconds.

restatements.text: Users must be able to export a report as PDF.
Reports shall be exportable to PDF by users.
Users shall be able to export reports as PDF.

alteration.text: Users shall not be able to export a report as PDF.

The server shall log every unsuccessful login attempt.
The server shall log all failed login attempts.
